threats.title: T-001: Customer Account Spoofing
threats.description: An attacker could impersonate a legitimate customer to place fraudulent orders or access order history.

threats.title: T-002: Staff Account Spoofing
threats.description: An attacker could impersonate staff to manipulate orders, access reports, or modify menu data.

threats.title: T-003: Web Application Server Spoofing
threats.description: An attacker might set up a fraudulent web server to phish user credentials.

threats.title: T-004: Order Data Tampering
threats.description: An attacker could modify order details (items, prices, status) in transit or at rest.

threats.title: T-010: Customer PII Disclosure
threats.description: Unauthorized access to customer names, contact details, and order history.

threats.title: T-011: Staff Credential Disclosure
threats.description: Exposure of staff usernames, passwords, or session tokens.

threats.title: T-016: Customer to Staff Privilege Escalation
threats.description: A customer could exploit a vulnerability to gain staff or administrator-level access.

threats.title: T-007: Application Code/Config Tampering
threats.description: Malicious modification of the application's source code or server configurations.

threats.title: T-008: Fraudulent Order Repudiation
threats.description: A user could claim they did not place an order to avoid payment or seek a refund.

threats.title: T-014: Web Application Server DoS
threats.description: An attacker could flood the server with requests, making it unavailable.

threats.title: T-018: Horizontal Privilege Escalation
threats.description: A customer gaining unauthorized access to another customer's account or data.
threats.mitigation: Provide remediation for this threat or a reason if status is N/A

threats.title: T-004: Order Data Tampering
threats.description: An attacker could modify order details (items, prices, status) at rest in the database.

threats.title: T-010: Customer PII Disclosure
threats.description: Unauthorized access to stored customer names and contact details.

threats.title: T-008: Fraudulent Order Repudiation
threats.description: If logs in the database are modified, a user could deny placing an order.

threats.title: T-015: MongoDB Database DoS
threats.description: Malicious or poorly optimized queries could overload the database, causing downtime.
